'''Zulma Nélida Brandoni de Gasparini''' (born 15 May 1944)<ref name=":0" /> is an Argentine [[paleontologist]] and [[zoologist]]. She is known for discovering the fossils of the dinosaur ''[[Gasparinisaura]]'', which was named after her.<ref>{{cite web|title = Museo de La Plata – FCNyM – UNLP – Importante reconocimiento a la trayectoria de la Dra. Zulma Brandoni de Gasparini|url = http://www.museo.fcnym.unlp.edu.ar/articulo/2012/11/28/gasparini|website = www.museo.fcnym.unlp.edu.ar|access-date = 2015-11-04|language = es|archive-date = 25 April 2015|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20150425225440/http://www.museo.fcnym.unlp.edu.ar/articulo/2012/11/28/gasparini|url-status = dead}}</ref>

== Work ==
Born in the city of [[La Plata]], Argentina, on 15 May 1944, Brandoni de Gasparini graduated in zoology from the [[National University of La Plata]] in 1966 and obtained her PhD in Natural Sciences in 1973.

Zulma Brandoni de Gasparini was internationally recognized in the nineties for leading the team that discovered the [[Gasparinisaura]].<ref>{{cite web|title = Científica argentina investiga una arcaica especie inexplorada|url = http://diarioepoca.com/91314/Cientandiacutefica-argentina-investiga-una-arcaica-especie-inexplorada/|website = Diario Epoca|access-date = 2015-11-04}}</ref> She is a recognized expert in Mesozoic reptilians of South America.<ref>{{cite web|title = Distinción a la Dra. Zulma Brandoni de Gasparini|url = http://apaleontologica.blogspot.be/2009/05/distincion-la-dra-zulma-brandoni-de.html|website = apaleontologica.blogspot.be|access-date = 2015-11-04|publisher=Asociación Paleontológica Argentina}}</ref>

In 1972, she started her scientific career at the [[National Scientific and Technical Research Council|CONICET]], where she was promoted in 2003 to the grade of ''Superior Researcher''.<ref name=":0">{{cite web|title = Dra. Brandoni de Gasparini, Zulma|url = http://www.ancefn.org.ar/institucional/docs/CVBrandoni-esp.pdf|website = www.ancefn.org.ar|access-date = 2015-11-04|publisher = ANCEFN – Academia Nacional de Ciencias Exactas, Fisicas y Naturales|archive-date = 4 March 2016|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20160304222851/http://www.ancefn.org.ar/institucional/docs/CVBrandoni-esp.pdf|url-status = dead}}</ref> She is today a professor in Paleontology of Vertebrates at the [[National University of La Plata]].

== Honours ==
Brandoni de Gasparini has been awarded, among others recognitions, the Prize "Bernardo Houssay" of the [[National Scientific and Technical Research Council|CONICET]] (1987), the Prize to the Merit of the Argentinian Paleontological Association (2001) and the Prize ''[[Florentino Ameghino]]'' of the National Academy of Exact and Natural Sciences (2002). She received the Prize ''[[Pellegrino Strobel]]'' in 2013.<ref>{{cite web|title = Se entregó el Premio Strobel 2013|url = http://www.uba.ar/comunicacion/noticia.php?id=3480|website = www.uba.ar|access-date = 2015-11-04|archive-date = 4 March 2016|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20160304054629/http://www.uba.ar/comunicacion/noticia.php?id=3480|url-status = dead}}</ref> In 2023, she was granted the [[Konex Award]] Merit Diploma for her work in Palaeontology in the last decade.<ref>{{cite web|access-date=2023-05-15|author=Fundación Konex|date=2 May 2023|language=es|title=Premios Konex 2023: Ciencia y Tecnología. Ya se conocen los Diplomas al Mérito|url=https://www.fundacionkonex.org/n1452-premios-konex-2023-ciencia-y-tecnologia-ya-se-conocen-los-diplomas-al-merito|website=fundacionkonex.org}}<!-- auto-translated by Module:CS1 translator --></ref>
